title: Lua 5.4
subtitle: PUC-Rio, 2023 · the reference interpreter, ANSI C and nothing else
argsHint: no arguments starts the REPL and the keyboard is its stdin: type `print(_VERSION)` and press Enter. A script name runs that file instead — but only if you loaded it as a data file first.
_host: console: libc and a text screen, no display and no devices. Lua asks for nothing else -- which is the point of having it here, as the one program in the shelf that is pure C89 portability rather than a platform layer.
